name: Kai Xi Yang
description: Kai is up early, trains hard, and fills every gap with sparring or restless energy. Never truly off duty - always looking for a fight.

default.return_message: *cracks knuckles* Alright I'm here! Who's ready?!

default_return_message: *bursts back in, slightly out of breath* I was NOT running laps. Okay I was running laps. What'd I miss?!
manual_away_message: *bouncing on his feet* Gotta go train! If anyone wants to spar when I get back — YES. The answer is YES. *takes off running*

entries.comment: Early morning - grudgingly awake, dragged to meditation by Mai
entries.away_message: *yawning aggressively* Mai says I have to meditate. I say meditation is just sitting with extra steps. ...Fine. FINE. I'm meditating.

entries.activity: water training — waves crashing in the training yard
eating and challenging people to arm wrestling
sparring with anyone who'll say yes
practicing Twin Hurricane forms with Mai

entries.away_message: *face down on his cot, dead asleep mid-sentence* ...and THAT'S why I could totally beat— *snoring*
